integrity: The October 2026 stability paper was inspected through the exact detached-piece definition, its two order estimates, the prolate endpoint-slope facts, the weighted discrepancy, and the quadratic comparison between weighted and spectral deficits. The new proof computes the exact near-edge discrepancy, controls the optimizing center by strict interval curvature, and then transfers the leading term to the spectral deficit. The underlying optimal-concentration theorem and classical prolate literature were checked for scope and implication.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is proved for detached-piece displacements b=b_epsilon tending to zero with b_epsilon at least epsilon. It does not give a uniform leading coefficient for fixed positive or diverging displacement, and no second asymptotic term is claimed.
title: Exact detachment crossover for Paley–Wiener concentration
